title: Design and investigation of a magnetic coupling piezoelectric inertial energy harvesting system for low-power wireless sensors in intercity buses
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,3935-3953
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00387C, Paper
Zhen Zhao, Xiaohui Zhang, Baifu Zhang, Haichuan Cui, Xinjun Li, Enyu He
This paper presents a magnetic coupling piezoelectric inertial energy harvesting system (MPIHS) designed to supply or store power for low-power wireless sensors by effectively recovering inertial energy generated during the operation of buses.
